speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Tachypnea, Subcostal and intercostal retractions, Nasal flaring, Cyanosis. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity (32 weeks), with consideration for transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) given the cesarean delivery and maternal gestational diabetes.
